tools.name: oref_current_alerts
tools.description: Active Home Front Command (Pikud HaOref) alerts in Israel right now (rockets, hostile aircraft, etc.). Optional city filter in Hebrew, e.g. 'חיפה'. The source is restricted to Israel, so this gateway reads it from an Israeli connection.

tools.name: oref_alert_history
tools.description: Recent Home Front Command alert history (last ~24h), newest first. Optional Hebrew city filter.

tools.name: grocery_find_stores
tools.description: Find Shufersal branches by city or name (Hebrew). Returns store_id values for grocery_search.

tools.name: grocery_search
tools.description: Current shelf prices at a specific Shufersal branch, from the official price-transparency files. Search by Hebrew product name (e.g. 'חלב 3%') or barcode. Results sorted cheapest first.

tools.name: datagov_search
tools.description: Search Israel's national open-data portal (data.gov.il). Hebrew queries work best. Returns datasets and their resource_id values for datagov_query.

tools.name: datagov_query
tools.description: Query rows from a data.gov.il resource (only resources marked queryable:true). Optional full-text filter.

tools.name: boi_exchange_rates
tools.description: Official Bank of Israel representative exchange rates (ILS). Optional list of currency codes.

tools.name: boi_convert
tools.description: Convert an amount between currencies using Bank of Israel representative rates.

tools.name: shabbat_times
tools.description: Candle lighting, havdalah and parasha for this week in an Israeli city (Hebrew or English name).

tools.name: israel_holidays
tools.description: Jewish/Israeli holidays for a year, with day_off=true for full holidays (yom tov).
